typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	tblOpicsSTPNonSTPVolumeSPLTStaging_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		STP_NONSTP as string,
		BUSINESS_GROUP as string,
		{COUNT(*)} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> LoadSPLT
LoadSPLT derive({Copy of BUSINESS_GROUP} = BUSINESS_GROUP,
		{Copy of STP_NONSTP} = STP_NONSTP,
		{Copy of COUNT(*)} = {COUNT(*)}) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion derive(LoadDate = toString(currentTimestamp())) ~> Loaddate
Loaddate sink(input(
		Loaddate as string,
		Business_Group as string,
		STP_NONSTP as string,
		Count as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Loaddate = LoadDate,
		Business_Group = {Copy of BUSINESS_GROUP},
		STP_NONSTP = {Copy of STP_NONSTP},
		Count = {Copy of COUNT(*)}),
	partitionFileNames:[($tblOpicsSTPNonSTPVolumeSPLTStaging_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> tblOpicsSTPNonSTPVolumeSPLTStaging
